data.body:
[P2] Record evidence for delegated validation

Rule 6 requires evidence for external behavior or an explicit “unverified” designation. This change delegates rejection of unsupported arguments to the model/service, but the description provides neither evidence covering the removed checks nor that designation. The new argument-forwarding test makes `FakeDecider` accept an empty question and oversized scale, so it cannot establish actual service behavior. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and document the relevant service contract or results, or mark this assumption unverified.
